## Section number

Which section of `SPEC.md` is this about (for example, "§6.3")?

## The exact statement

Quote the exact sentence or rule you have a question about.

## Your question or the problem you found

Is the statement unclear, incomplete, or inconsistent with another part of
`SPEC.md`? Is it inconsistent with the reference implementation? Describe
the problem as specifically as you can.
